proposals.before: Enfeoffed the Palace Attendant Xu Jia, uterine younger brother of the emperor's maternal grandfather, Marquis Dai of Ping'en, as Marquis of Ping'en to continue Marquis Dai's line.
proposals.after: Enfeoffed the Palace Attendant Xu Jia, son of a uterine younger brother of the emperor's maternal grandfather Marquis Dai of Ping'en, as Marquis of Ping'en to continue Marquis Dai's line.
proposals.reason: 同產弟子 means the son of a same-mother younger brother (a nephew), not the uterine younger brother himself.

proposals.before: Jia Guanyin, an Awaiting Edict, argued that Zhujia should be abandoned to relieve the people's famine and distress.
proposals.after: Jia Juanzhi, an Awaiting Edict, argued that Zhuya should be abandoned to relieve the people's famine and distress.
proposals.reason: 賈捐之 is Jia Juanzhi, not Jia Guanyin; also align the place name with Zhuya used in the prior sentence.

proposals.before: Jia Guanyin, an Awaiting Edict, argued that Zhujia should be abandoned to relieve the people's famine and distress.
proposals.after: Awaiting Edict Jia Juanzhi considered it appropriate to abandon Zhuya, to save the people from famine.
proposals.reason: Correct the personal name 賈捐之 to Jia Juanzhi in the literal rendering.

proposals.before: On the last day of the fourth month of summer, which fell on Yiyou, the white crane pavilion at Maoling suffered a disaster.
proposals.after: On the last day of the fourth month of summer, which fell on Yiwei, the white crane pavilion at Maoling suffered a disaster.
proposals.reason: 乙未 is Yiwei, not Yiyou (乙酉).

proposals.before: In the first month of spring in the fifth year, Zhouzi Nanjun was made Zhou Chenghou Marquis, his position ranking after the feudal kings.
proposals.after: In the first month of spring in the fifth year, the Lord of Zhouzinan was made Marquis of Chengxiu of Zhou, his position ranking after the feudal kings.
proposals.reason: 周子南君 is a title (Lord of Zhouzinan); 周承休侯 is Marquis of Chengxiu of Zhou, not Zhou Chenghou.

proposals.before: In the third month, Crown Prince Kang was established as King of Jiyang.
proposals.after: In the third month, the imperial son Kang was established as King of Jiyang.
proposals.reason: 皇子 means imperial son, not Crown Prince (皇太子).

proposals.before: In the sixth month, Crown Prince Xing was established as King of Xindu.
proposals.after: In the sixth month, the imperial son Xing was established as King of Xindu.
proposals.reason: 皇子 means imperial son, not Crown Prince (皇太子).

proposals.before: Young and good Confucianism, and ascended position, summoned used Confucian scholars, entrusted them with government, Gong, Xue, Wei, Kuang alternately became chancellors.
proposals.after: From youth he loved Confucianism; when he ascended the throne, he summoned and employed Confucian scholars and entrusted government to them; Gong, Xue, Wei, and Kuang became chancellors in turn.
proposals.reason: Literal English is ungrammatical and obscures the accession and appointment sequence clearly present in the Chinese.

proposals.before: Enfeoffed the Palace Attendant Xu Jia, uterine younger brother of the maternal grandfather, Marquis Dai of Ping'en, as Marquis of Ping'en to continue Marquis Dai's line.
proposals.after: Enfeoffed Xu Jia, Palace Regular Attendant and son of a full younger brother of the maternal grandfather, Marquis Dai of Ping'en, as Marquis of Ping'en to continue Marquis Dai's line.
proposals.reason: 同產弟子 identifies Xu Jia as the son of the maternal grandfather's full younger brother, and 中常侍 is Palace Regular Attendant.

proposals.before: Summer fourth month Yiyou last day, Maoling white crane pavilion disaster.
proposals.after: On the last day of the fourth month of summer, an Yiwei day, the White Crane Lodge at Maoling burned.
proposals.reason: 乙未 is Yiwei, not Yiyou, and 災 here records that the lodge burned.

proposals.before: Fifth year spring first month, used Zhou son Nanjun as Zhou Chenghou Marquis, position ranked feudal lords kings.
proposals.after: In the first month of spring in the fifth year, Lord Zhouzinan was made Marquis of Zhou Chengxiu, his rank immediately below the kings.
proposals.reason: The original misparsed both noble titles and left the rank clause ungrammatical.

proposals.before: Third month, established crown prince Kang as Jiyang King.
proposals.after: In the third month, the emperor's son Kang was made King of Jiyang.
proposals.reason: 皇子 means the emperor's son, not Crown Prince.

proposals.before: Sixth month, established crown prince Xing as Xindu King.
proposals.after: In the sixth month, the emperor's son Xing was made King of Xindu.
proposals.reason: 皇子 means the emperor's son, not Crown Prince.

decisions.after: Enfeoffed Xu Jia, Palace Regular Attendant and son of a full younger brother of the emperor's maternal grandfather, Marquis Dai of Ping'en, as Marquis of Ping'en to continue Marquis Dai's line.
decisions.reason: 同產弟子 is the son of a full younger brother, not the younger brother himself; the revision also uses the established rendering of 中常侍.
